# lean-pkg site

a package's documentation site (proposal 0012): `site check` reads it offline (Jekyll, MkDocs or a static site served as committed).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg site [--json] [COMMAND]
```

## Subcommands

- [`lean-pkg site check`](site-check.md): read-only: check the site in DIR (default docs): generated pages current and linked, Markdown inside HTML blocks, mathematics, the noindex while private, the files it serves, a shadowing index.html; hand-written counts are warnings; exit 0/1

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).
